passages.title: 卡在樹上的小貓
passages.text: Our kitten, Mochi, is very {1}. She wants to know what is inside every box and behind every door. Last Saturday, she saw a bird in the tree in our yard. She climbed higher and higher, and then she {2} she couldn't get down. She started to cry loudly. My brother wanted to climb up and grab her, but my dad said, "Be {3}. If we scare her, she might fall." So we waited under the tree with her favorite food. Thirty minutes passed, then an hour. My brother was bored and went inside. Finally, Mochi slowly came down, one step at a time. She looked very {4} when she jumped onto the grass, as if nothing had happened. Then she walked past us and ate all her food. "That's our cat," Dad said with a laugh. "She causes trouble, and we {5} for her."

blanks.why: 想知道每個箱子裡有什麼，小貓很「好奇」curious。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容貓的個性。
realized she couldn't get down「發現自己下不來」，後面接子句。borrow（借）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接子句表示發現。
爸爸說要「有耐心」be patient，嚇到牠可能會掉下來。crowded、sour（酸的）、wooden（木製的）都不能用來勸人等待。
跳到草地上一副若無其事、很「有自信」的樣子 confident。illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）、plastic（塑膠的）都不能形容貓的神態。
wait for her「等她」。spell、invite（邀請）、boil（煮沸）都不能接 for her 表示等待。

passages.zh: 我們的小貓麻糬非常好奇，她想知道每個箱子裡有什麼、每扇門後面有什麼。上星期六，她看到院子裡的樹上有一隻鳥，就愈爬愈高，結果發現自己下不來，開始大聲哭叫。我哥哥想爬上去抓她，但爸爸說：「要有耐心，如果我們嚇到她，她可能會掉下來。」於是我們拿著她最愛的食物在樹下等。三十分鐘過去了，接著一個小時過去了。哥哥覺得無聊，就進屋去了。最後，麻糬一步一步慢慢地爬下來。她跳到草地上時，一副很有自信的樣子，好像什麼事都沒發生過。然後她從我們旁邊走過去，把食物全部吃光。「這就是我們家的貓，」爸爸笑著說，「她惹麻煩，我們等她。」

passages.title: 火星上的好奇號
passages.text: In 2012, a robot called Curiosity {1} on Mars. It is about the size of a small car. Scientists gave it this name because humans are {2} about the red planet. Was there ever water on Mars? Could anything live there? Curiosity's job is to find the answers. The robot moves very slowly—only about 150 meters an hour. The scientists who control it have to be very {3}. A message from Earth takes about 14 minutes to reach Mars, so they can't drive it like a video game. They also can't be {4}. One small mistake could break the robot, and no one can go to Mars to fix it. So far, Curiosity has found signs that Mars had lakes a long time ago. The scientists are now {5} that Mars was once very different. Maybe one day, people will walk on Mars and see Curiosity with their own eyes.

blanks.why: landed on Mars「登陸火星」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接 on Mars 表示降落。
be curious about...「對……好奇」，所以取名為「好奇號」。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能接 about the red planet。
機器人動得很慢、訊息要 14 分鐘才到，控制的人要很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容科學家。
一個小錯就會弄壞機器人，所以不能「粗心」careless。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都和「小錯誤」無關。
be confident that...「有把握……」，發現了湖的證據。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 2012 年，一台叫做「好奇號」的機器人登陸火星。它大約和一台小汽車一樣大。科學家取這個名字，是因為人類對這顆紅色星球很好奇：火星上曾經有水嗎？那裡會有生物嗎？好奇號的工作就是找出答案。這台機器人移動得非常慢，一小時只走大約 150 公尺。控制它的科學家必須非常有耐心。一則訊息從地球傳到火星大約要 14 分鐘，所以他們沒辦法像玩電動一樣開它。他們也不能粗心，一個小錯誤就可能弄壞機器人，而且沒有人能去火星修理它。到目前為止，好奇號已經發現火星很久以前有湖泊的跡象。科學家現在很有把握，火星曾經和現在很不一樣。也許有一天，人們會走在火星上，親眼看到好奇號。

passages.title: 粗心大意的數學考試
passages.text: When I got my math test back, I couldn't believe my eyes. I got 68! I had studied hard for a whole week, and I knew how to {1} every problem. So what went wrong? I looked at my paper carefully. On question 3, I wrote 7 × 8 = 54. On question 9, I forgot to {2} the minus sign from the question. On question 12, I didn't even read the whole question. They were all {3} mistakes. My teacher, Mr. Wu, was very {4} with me. He didn't say I was stupid. He just said, "You know the math. Now you need to slow down." He gave me a tip: after finishing a test, use the last ten minutes to check every answer. On the next test, I did what he said, and I found three mistakes before I handed it in. I got 92. Now I feel much more {5} about math tests.

blanks.why: solve every problem「解每一題」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、invite（邀請）都不能和 problem 搭配表示解題。
copy the minus sign「把負號抄過來」。borrow（借）、marry、boil（煮沸）都不能表示從題目抄下符號。
careless mistakes「粗心造成的錯誤」，題目都會，只是寫錯、漏看。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容錯誤。
be patient with me「對我很有耐心」，沒罵我笨。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容老師的態度。
feel confident about...「對……有信心」，考了 92 分之後。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、rainy（下雨的）都不能形容心情。

passages.zh: 拿回數學考卷時，我不敢相信自己的眼睛：我考了 68 分！我認真讀了一整個星期，每一題我都會解。到底哪裡出錯了？我仔細看我的考卷。第 3 題我寫 7 × 8 = 54；第 9 題我忘了把題目裡的負號抄過來；第 12 題我甚至沒有把題目讀完。全都是粗心的錯誤。吳老師對我很有耐心，他沒有說我笨，只是說：「數學你都會，現在你需要放慢速度。」他給我一個訣竅：寫完考卷後，用最後十分鐘檢查每一個答案。下一次考試，我照他說的做，交卷前就找到三個錯誤，結果考了 92 分。現在我對數學考試有信心多了。

passages.title: 餐廳裡的奧客
passages.text: My parents own a small noodle restaurant near our school. Most customers are friendly, but last Sunday, a man was very {1}. He {2} at my mom because his noodles took ten minutes. Then he said the soup was too salty and threw his chopsticks on the table. Everyone in the restaurant stopped eating and looked at him. I was so angry that I wanted to say something, but my mom stopped me. She was {3} and calm. She said sorry, made him a new bowl, and didn't charge him for it. After he left, I asked her, "Why were you so nice to him?" She smiled. "Maybe he had a bad day," she said. "If I'm rude back, two people have a bad day." A week later, the man came back. This time he was quiet and {4}. Before he left, he said sorry to my mom and {5} a small card on the table. It said, "Thank you for being kind."

blanks.why: 對媽媽大吼、亂丟筷子，這個人很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人的行為。
shouted at my mom「對媽媽大吼」。borrow（借）、marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）都不能接 at my mom。
媽媽很「有耐心」又冷靜 patient and calm，重新煮一碗。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能和 calm 並列形容人。
這次他安靜又「有耐心」quiet and patient，和上次等十分鐘就大吼相反。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的態度。
left a card on the table「在桌上留了一張卡片」，leave 的過去式 left。spelled、married、borrowed 都不能接 on the table 表示留下東西。

passages.zh: 我爸媽在學校附近開了一家小麵店。大部分的客人都很友善，但上星期天，有個男人非常沒禮貌。他因為麵等了十分鐘就對我媽媽大吼，接著又說湯太鹹，還把筷子丟在桌上。店裡每個人都停下來看著他。我氣到想說話，但媽媽阻止了我。她很有耐心，也很冷靜，向他道歉，幫他重新煮了一碗，而且沒有收錢。他走了以後，我問媽媽：「你為什麼要對他那麼好？」她笑著說：「也許他今天過得很糟。如果我也對他沒禮貌，就會有兩個人過得很糟。」一個星期後，那個男人又來了。這次他很安靜、很有耐心。離開前，他向媽媽道歉，還在桌上留下一張小卡片，上面寫著：「謝謝你的親切。」

passages.title: 釣魚的阿公
passages.text: Every Sunday morning, my grandpa takes me fishing at a river near his house. He is the most {1} person I know. He can sit by the water for five hours without catching anything, and he still looks happy. I'm the opposite. After twenty minutes, I {2} bored. "Why aren't the fish coming?" I ask again and again. Grandpa always says the same thing: "Fish don't like people who talk too much." Last Sunday, I was {3} and left my fishing rod on the ground while I went to buy a drink. When I came back, it was moving toward the water! A big fish had taken the bait. Grandpa jumped up and caught the rod just in time. Together, we {4} out a fish as long as my arm. I was so excited that I jumped up and down. Grandpa laughed and said, "See? Good things come to those who wait." Now I feel more {5} about fishing, and I talk a little less.

blanks.why: 坐五小時沒釣到魚還很開心，阿公是最「有耐心」的人 the most patient。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
get bored「變得無聊、不耐煩」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接形容詞 bored。
把釣竿丟在地上自己跑去買飲料，很「粗心」careless。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人的行為。
pulled out a fish「把魚拉出來」。spelled、married、invited 都不能接 out a fish。
釣到大魚後，對釣魚更「有信心」confident。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容心情。

passages.zh: 每個星期天早上，阿公都會帶我去他家附近的河邊釣魚。他是我認識最有耐心的人，可以在水邊坐五個小時一條魚也沒釣到，看起來還是很開心。我剛好相反，二十分鐘後就覺得無聊了。「魚為什麼還不來？」我一問再問。阿公總是說同一句話：「魚不喜歡話太多的人。」上星期天，我很粗心，去買飲料時把釣竿放在地上。回來時，釣竿正往水裡移動！一條大魚咬住了魚餌。阿公跳起來，及時抓住了釣竿。我們一起拉起一條跟我手臂一樣長的魚。我興奮得跳上跳下。阿公笑著說：「看吧？好事會留給願意等待的人。」現在我對釣魚更有信心了，話也少了一點。

passages.title: 上台演講之前
passages.text: Last month, I was chosen to give a speech at our school's English contest. I was so {1} that I couldn't sleep the night before. I'm usually shy, and I don't like people looking at me. My English teacher, Ms. Lee, helped me practice every day after school. She was very {2}. Even when I made the same mistake ten times, she never got angry. "Look up and smile," she said. "Even if you don't feel {3}, you can act like it." She also told me not to be {4} with my words. "Speak slowly and clearly. Don't rush." On the day of the contest, my legs were shaking when I walked onto the stage. But I looked up, smiled, and started. After the first sentence, I felt much better. I didn't win first place, but I got third. When I came down from the stage, Ms. Lee gave me a big hug. Now I'm not so {5} of speaking in front of people.

blanks.why: 害怕到前一晚睡不著 so scared that...。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人的心情。
我同樣的錯誤犯十次她也不生氣，老師很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容老師。
就算不覺得「有自信」，也可以裝得有自信 feel confident。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容演講時的感覺。
不要對用字「粗心」be careless with words，要慢慢說清楚。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 with my words。
be afraid of...「害怕……」。delicious、wooden、cheap 都不能接 of speaking 表示害怕。

passages.zh: 上個月，我被選上參加學校的英文演講比賽。我害怕到前一晚都睡不著。我平常很害羞，不喜歡別人看著我。英文老師李老師每天放學後陪我練習，她非常有耐心，就算我同一個錯誤犯了十次，她也從來不生氣。「抬起頭，微笑，」她說，「就算你不覺得有自信，也可以表現得很有自信。」她也告訴我說話時用字不要粗心：「慢慢說、說清楚，不要急。」比賽那天，我走上台時雙腿都在發抖。但我抬起頭、微笑，然後開始演講。說完第一句之後，我就覺得好多了。我沒有得第一名，但拿到第三名。我走下台時，李老師給了我一個大大的擁抱。現在我沒那麼害怕在別人面前說話了。

passages.title: 小王子的狐狸
passages.text: In the famous book The Little Prince, a little prince from a small planet comes to Earth. One day, he meets a fox in a field. The prince wants to play with him, but the fox says he can't. "I'm not tamed," the fox explains. "To tame me, you must be {1}." The fox tells the prince to sit a little far from him at first. Every day, the prince should come at the same time and sit a little closer. The prince is {2} and asks many questions, but he does what the fox says. Slowly, they become friends. The fox teaches the prince an important lesson: the things we spend time on become special to us. That's why the prince's rose, which he takes care of every day, is different from all the other roses in the world. Because the prince was not {3} with his rose, it {4} his own. When I read this story, I thought about my friends. Friendship takes time, and we should never be {5} to the people we love.

blanks.why: 要馴服狐狸必須「有耐心」be patient，每天慢慢靠近。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能說明馴服的條件。
小王子很「好奇」curious，問了很多問題。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容小王子。
小王子沒有「隨便、粗心地」對待玫瑰 not careless with his rose。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 with his rose 表示對待方式。
it became his own「它成了他獨一無二的玫瑰」。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能接 his own 表示「變成」。
be rude to...「對……沒禮貌」，我們不該這樣對待所愛的人。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 to the people 形容態度。

passages.zh: 在有名的書《小王子》裡，一位來自小星球的小王子來到地球。有一天，他在田野遇到一隻狐狸。小王子想跟牠玩，但狐狸說不行。「我還沒有被馴服，」狐狸解釋，「要馴服我，你必須有耐心。」狐狸要小王子一開始坐得離牠遠一點，之後每天在同一個時間來，坐得更近一點。小王子很好奇，問了很多問題，但他照著狐狸說的做。慢慢地，他們成了朋友。狐狸教了小王子重要的一課：我們花時間在上面的東西，會變得對我們很特別。所以小王子每天照顧的那朵玫瑰，和世界上所有其他玫瑰都不一樣。因為小王子沒有隨便對待他的玫瑰，它才成為他獨一無二的玫瑰。讀這個故事時，我想到了我的朋友們。友誼需要時間，我們永遠不該對所愛的人沒禮貌。

passages.title: 魔法學徒的大災難
passages.text: Long ago, an old wizard had a young helper named Leo. Leo was {1} about magic, but he was also {2}. He never listened carefully to the wizard's lessons. One day, the wizard went out and told Leo to fill a big pot with water from the well. Leo didn't want to {3} all that water himself. So he opened the wizard's magic book and read a spell. A broom suddenly stood up and began carrying buckets of water. Leo was very happy—until the pot was full and the broom didn't stop. Water was everywhere! Leo didn't know how to stop the spell. When the wizard came home, the whole room was a lake. He said one word, and the broom fell down. Leo thought the wizard would be angry, but he was {4}. "Magic is powerful," he said. "You must learn before you use it." After that day, Leo was never {5} in his lessons again.

blanks.why: be curious about magic「對魔法很好奇」。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能接 about magic。
從來不認真聽課，所以很「粗心」careless。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人的個性。
不想自己「提」那麼多水 carry all that water。marry（結婚）、invite（邀請）、pray（祈禱）都不能接 water 表示搬運。
以為巫師會生氣，但他很「有耐心」patient，只是教導他。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容巫師的態度。
從那天起上課再也不「偷懶」lazy。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容學生上課的態度。（lazy 是 D136 的字，用來複習。）

passages.zh: 很久以前，一位老巫師有個叫 Leo 的年輕助手。Leo 對魔法很好奇，但也很粗心，從來不認真聽巫師上課。有一天，巫師出門前要 Leo 從井裡打水，把一個大鍋子裝滿。Leo 不想自己提那麼多水，就打開巫師的魔法書，念了一段咒語。一支掃帚突然站了起來，開始一桶一桶地提水。Leo 很開心——直到鍋子滿了，掃帚卻沒有停下來。到處都是水！Leo 不知道怎麼解除咒語。巫師回到家時，整個房間已經變成一座湖。他只說了一個字，掃帚就倒下了。Leo 以為巫師會生氣，但他很有耐心。「魔法很強大，」他說，「你必須先學會，才能使用它。」從那天起，Leo 上課再也不偷懶了。

passages.title: 捷運上的博愛座
passages.text: Yesterday on the MRT, I saw something that made me angry. An old woman got on the train with a heavy bag. All the seats were full. A young man was sitting in a priority seat, playing a game on his phone. He saw her, but he didn't {1}. He just looked down at his phone again. I thought he was very {2}. Then a girl in a school uniform stood up and gave the old woman her seat. The woman thanked her with a big smile. A few stops later, the young man stood up to get off, and I saw that he was using a crutch. His leg was hurt! I felt bad. I was {3} to judge him so quickly. Maybe he didn't feel well enough to stand. I learned that we should be {4} and not decide too fast about other people. We don't always know their story. But the girl in the uniform was still my hero. She was {5} and kind, and she didn't wait for someone else to help.

blanks.why: 他看到老太太卻沒有「移動、讓位」didn't move。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能單獨表示讓座的動作。
看到老人也不讓座，我覺得他很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
這麼快就評斷他，是我太「粗心、草率」careless。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 to judge him 形容我的做法。
應該「有耐心」be patient，不要太快下結論。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能說明對待別人的態度。
女孩「有自信」又善良，不等別人先幫忙 confident and kind。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能和 kind 並列形容人。

passages.zh: 昨天在捷運上，我看到一件讓我生氣的事。一位老太太提著很重的袋子上車，所有座位都滿了。一個年輕男子坐在博愛座上玩手機遊戲。他看到了她，卻沒有起身，只是又低頭看手機。我覺得他非常沒禮貌。接著，一位穿制服的女學生站起來，把座位讓給老太太，老太太笑著向她道謝。幾站之後，那個年輕男子站起來準備下車，我才看到他拄著拐杖——他的腿受傷了！我覺得很不好意思，我太草率了，這麼快就評斷他。也許他身體不舒服，沒辦法站。我學到我們應該有耐心，不要太快對別人下結論，因為我們不一定知道別人的故事。不過，那個穿制服的女孩仍是我心中的英雄。她有自信又善良，沒有等別人先出手幫忙。

passages.title: 急診室的護理師
passages.text: My mom is a nurse in the emergency room of a big hospital in Taichung. Her job is not easy. Every day, she takes care of many {1}. Some have broken legs, and some have high fevers. Some come in after car accidents. My mom has to be very {2}. If she gives someone the wrong medicine, it could be dangerous. She also has to be {3}. Sick people are often scared, and they ask the same questions again and again. Sometimes people are even {4} to her because they have waited for hours. She told me that one man once shouted at her and called her stupid. "How did you feel?" I asked. "I felt sad," she said, "but I understood. He was in a lot of pain." My mom works long hours, and she often comes home very tired. But she always says she loves her job. "When a patient goes home {5}, I feel it's all worth it."

blanks.why: take care of many patients「照顧很多病人」，這裡 patient 是名詞「病人」。tickets（票）、habits（習慣）、sentences（句子）都不需要護理師照顧。
給錯藥會很危險，所以要很「小心」careful。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容護理師的工作態度。
病人會一再問同樣的問題，所以要「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人。
等太久，有時甚至對她「沒禮貌」be rude to her。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 to her 形容態度。
go home safe「平安地回家」。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、wooden 都不能形容出院的病人。

passages.zh: 我媽媽是台中一家大醫院急診室的護理師。她的工作不輕鬆，每天要照顧很多病人：有的人腿斷了，有的人發高燒，有的人是出車禍才進來的。媽媽必須非常小心，如果給錯藥，可能會很危險。她也必須很有耐心，因為生病的人常常很害怕，會一再問同樣的問題。有時候，人們因為等了好幾個小時，甚至會對她很沒禮貌。她告訴我，有一次一個男人對她大吼，還罵她笨。「你那時覺得怎樣？」我問。「我很難過，」她說，「但我能理解，他那時非常痛。」媽媽工作時間很長，常常回到家就累壞了。但她總是說她喜歡她的工作。「當病人平安回家時，我就覺得一切都值得了。」

passages.title: 音樂劇試鏡
passages.text: Our school is doing a musical this year, and I really wanted to get the main part. On the day of the audition, I waited outside the music room with twenty other students. Some of them looked very {1}. They were singing loudly and joking with each other. I felt small. When my name was called, my hands were cold. Inside, the music teacher smiled at me. "Take your time," she said. She was very {2} and let me start again when I forgot the first line. The second time, I closed my eyes and {3} I was singing in my bedroom. My voice became stronger. After the audition, a tall girl in my class laughed and said, "You'll never get the part." She was so {4} that I almost cried. But a week later, the list was on the wall. I got the main part! I learned that you don't have to be loud to be good. You just need to {5} and believe in yourself.

blanks.why: 大聲唱歌、互開玩笑，看起來很「有自信」confident。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
我忘詞時讓我重來，老師很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容老師。
imagined (that) I was singing...「想像自己在房間唱歌」，後面接子句。married、borrowed、spelled 都不能接子句。
說我永遠拿不到角色，「沒禮貌」到我差點哭 so rude that...。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的態度。
You need to practice「你需要練習」。marry（結婚）、invite（邀請）、boil（煮沸）都不能說明怎麼變得更好。

passages.zh: 我們學校今年要演一齣音樂劇，我非常想演主角。試鏡那天，我和其他二十個學生在音樂教室外面等。有些人看起來非常有自信，大聲唱歌、互相開玩笑。我覺得自己好渺小。叫到我的名字時，我的手冰冰的。進去以後，音樂老師對我微笑。「慢慢來。」她說。她非常有耐心，我忘了第一句歌詞時，她讓我重新開始。第二次，我閉上眼睛，想像自己在房間裡唱歌，聲音就變得比較有力了。試鏡結束後，班上一個高個子女生笑著說：「你永遠拿不到那個角色的。」她沒禮貌到我差點哭出來。但一個星期後，名單貼在牆上：我拿到主角了！我學到，不一定要很大聲才會表現得好，你只需要練習，並且相信自己。

passages.title: 好奇的外星人
passages.text: One night, a small spaceship landed in a rice field in Yilan. A little green alien named Zip climbed out. Zip was very {1} about Earth. He wanted to see everything. First, he walked into a convenience store. He touched the bottles, smelled the tea eggs, and {2} to talk to the coffee machine. The clerk was surprised, but she wasn't {3} to him. She smiled and gave him a free rice ball. Next, Zip went to a night market. There were so many people! A man stepped on his foot and didn't say sorry. Zip didn't understand. On his planet, everyone was polite. Then a little boy showed Zip how to play a game. He was {4} and explained the rules three times. Zip won a toy fish! Before sunrise, Zip went back to his spaceship. He was {5} that Earth was a strange but wonderful place, and he promised to come back next year.

blanks.why: be curious about Earth「對地球很好奇」，什麼都想看。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能接 about Earth。
tried to talk to...「試著和咖啡機說話」。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 to talk。
店員雖然驚訝但沒有對他「沒禮貌」wasn't rude to him，還送他飯糰。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 to him 形容態度。
解釋規則三次，小男孩很「有耐心」patient。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容小孩。
be confident that...「確信……」。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 that 子句。

passages.zh: 一天晚上，一艘小太空船降落在宜蘭的一片稻田裡。一個叫 Zip 的綠色小外星人爬了出來。Zip 對地球非常好奇，什麼都想看。他先走進一家便利商店，摸摸瓶子、聞聞茶葉蛋，還試著和咖啡機說話。店員嚇了一跳，但她沒有對他沒禮貌，反而笑著送他一個免費的飯糰。接著，Zip 去了夜市，那裡好多人！有個男人踩到他的腳，卻沒有說對不起。Zip 不明白，因為在他的星球上，大家都很有禮貌。後來，一個小男孩教 Zip 玩一個遊戲。他很有耐心，把規則解釋了三次，結果 Zip 贏到一隻玩具魚！天亮之前，Zip 回到太空船。他確信地球是個奇怪但美好的地方，並答應明年還會再來。

passages.title: 送錯的包裹
passages.text: Last Monday, a delivery man brought a big box to our door. My mom was surprised because she didn't order anything. When we opened it, we found a pink dress for a little girl, three bottles of shampoo, and a book about cats. "Someone was {1}," my mom said. "This isn't ours." She {2} the label on the box. The address was right, but the name was wrong. It was for a family on the third floor, not the fifth. My little brother was very {3} about the cat book and wanted to keep it. "No," Mom said. "We have to return everything." So we took the box downstairs. A young mother opened the door. She was so happy because the dress was a birthday gift for her daughter. She thanked us again and again. She wasn't {4} at all—she even gave us a box of cookies. My brother was happy too. On the way upstairs, he said, "Being {5} is better than a cat book. Cookies are better."

blanks.why: 不是我們的東西卻送來，有人很「粗心」careless。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容送錯東西的人。
checked the label「檢查箱子上的標籤」。married、spelled、invited 都不能和 label 搭配表示查看。
be curious about the cat book「對貓的書很好奇」，想留下來。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容弟弟。
她一點也不「沒禮貌」，還送我們餅乾 wasn't rude at all。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的態度。
Being honest「誠實」，把東西還回去。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、wooden 都不能形容歸還包裹的行為。

passages.zh: 上星期一，送貨員送來一個大箱子到我們家門口。媽媽很驚訝，因為她什麼都沒買。我們打開一看，裡面有一件小女孩穿的粉紅色洋裝、三瓶洗髮精，還有一本關於貓的書。「有人太粗心了，」媽媽說，「這不是我們的。」她檢查箱子上的標籤，地址沒錯，但名字錯了——那是要給三樓的人家，不是五樓。我弟弟對那本貓的書很好奇，想留下來。「不行，」媽媽說，「我們必須把東西全部還回去。」於是我們把箱子搬下樓。一位年輕媽媽開了門，她好開心，因為那件洋裝是要給女兒的生日禮物。她一再向我們道謝，一點也沒有不禮貌，還送我們一盒餅乾。弟弟也很開心。上樓時他說：「誠實比一本貓的書好。餅乾更好。」

passages.title: 網路上的留言
passages.text: My cousin Amy loves to sing. Last month, she {1} a video of herself singing on the Internet. Many people left nice comments, but some people were very {2}. One person wrote, "Stop singing. You sound like a sick cat." Amy cried for a whole night. She didn't want to sing anymore. Her older brother sat with her and talked to her. He was {3} and listened to her for two hours. "People who write mean things online are usually not happy themselves," he said. "Don't let them {4} who you are." He also told her not to be {5} with her personal information online. "Never tell strangers your school or your address," he said. A week later, Amy started singing again. She doesn't read the bad comments anymore. She's much more confident now, and her new video has 5,000 views. I'm really proud of her.

blanks.why: shared a video「分享一支影片」。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能接 a video on the Internet。
留言說她像生病的貓，有些人很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容留言的人。
陪她聽了兩小時，哥哥很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容哥哥。
Don't let them decide who you are.「別讓他們決定你是怎樣的人」。marry（結婚）、invite（邀請）、boil（煮沸）都不能接 who you are。
be careless with personal information「對個人資料不小心」。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 with... information。

passages.zh: 我表姊 Amy 很喜歡唱歌。上個月，她在網路上傳了一支自己唱歌的影片。很多人留了好話，但有些人非常沒禮貌。有個人寫：「別唱了，你聽起來像一隻生病的貓。」Amy 哭了一整晚，不想再唱歌了。她哥哥坐在她旁邊陪她聊，很有耐心地聽她說了兩個小時。「在網路上寫刻薄話的人，通常自己也不快樂，」他說，「別讓他們決定你是怎樣的人。」他也告訴她，在網路上不要對個人資料太粗心。「絕對不要告訴陌生人你的學校或地址。」一個星期後，Amy 又開始唱歌了。她不再看那些壞留言，現在有自信多了，她的新影片有五千次觀看。我真的以她為榮。

passages.title: 教阿嬤用平板
passages.text: For her eightieth birthday, we gave my grandma a tablet. She was happy, but she didn't know how to use it. "It's too {1} for an old woman," she said. So every Sunday, I teach her. At first, I wasn't very {2}. When she pressed the wrong button again, I said, "No, Grandma! Not that one!" She looked sad and put the tablet down. I felt terrible. I remembered how she taught me to tie my shoes when I was little. She never shouted at me. So I {3} the way I taught her. I wrote the steps on a card in big letters. I let her try by herself and only helped when she asked. Grandma is very {4}, so she learned quickly. Now she can make video calls to my uncle in Canada and watch Taiwanese operas online. She is so {5} that last week, she taught her friend how to take selfies!

blanks.why: too difficult for an old woman「對老人家來說太難」。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容平板的使用方式。
她按錯就大聲說「不是那個」，我一開始不太「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容教人的態度。
changed the way I taught her「改變教她的方式」。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能接 the way 表示改變方法。
阿嬤很「好奇」curious，所以學得很快。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的個性。
「有自信」到能教朋友自拍 so confident that...。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、wooden 都不能形容阿嬤。

passages.zh: 阿嬤八十歲生日時，我們送她一台平板電腦。她很開心，可是不會用。「這對老人家來說太難了。」她說。所以每個星期天，我都教她。一開始我不太有耐心，她又按錯按鈕時，我說：「不對啦，阿嬤！不是那個！」她看起來很難過，把平板放了下來。我覺得很糟糕。我想起小時候她教我綁鞋帶，她從來沒有對我大吼。所以我改變了教她的方式：我把步驟用大字寫在卡片上，讓她自己試，只有她問我時才幫忙。阿嬤很好奇，所以學得很快。現在她能和在加拿大的舅舅視訊，還會上網看歌仔戲。她有自信到上星期還教她的朋友怎麼自拍呢！

passages.title: 十萬個為什麼的妹妹
passages.text: My little sister, Ruby, is five years old, and she is the most {1} person in our family. She asks "Why?" about a hundred times a day. "Why is the sky blue?" "Why do cats have tails?" "Why can't I eat ice cream for breakfast?" Sometimes I don't know the answer, so I just say, "Because." But my dad is different. He is very {2}. He always tries to answer her questions, and when he doesn't know, he says, "Let's find out together." Then they look it up in a book or online. Last week, Ruby asked, "Why do we have to say 'please'?" Dad said, "Because if we don't, people might think we are {3}." Ruby thought about it and then said, "Then why don't dogs say 'please'?" Dad laughed so hard that he couldn't {4}. I used to think Ruby's questions were annoying, but now I think they're cute. Maybe one day she'll become a scientist. She's already {5} enough to ask anything!

blanks.why: 一天問一百次「為什麼」，妹妹是最「好奇」的人 the most curious。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
總是試著回答她的問題，爸爸很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容爸爸。
不說「請」，別人可能覺得我們「沒禮貌」rude。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容不說「請」的人。
笑到沒辦法「回答」couldn't answer。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能說明爸爸笑到做不到的事。
confident enough to ask anything「有足夠自信什麼都敢問」。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、wooden 都不能形容妹妹。

passages.zh: 我妹妹 Ruby 五歲，是我們家最好奇的人。她一天大概問一百次「為什麼」：「為什麼天空是藍色的？」「為什麼貓有尾巴？」「為什麼我不能早餐吃冰淇淋？」有時候我不知道答案，就只說：「因為就是這樣。」但爸爸不一樣，他非常有耐心，總是試著回答她的問題；不知道的時候，他會說：「我們一起找答案吧。」然後他們就去翻書或上網查。上星期，Ruby 問：「為什麼我們要說『請』？」爸爸說：「因為如果不說，別人可能會覺得我們很沒禮貌。」Ruby 想了想，又問：「那為什麼狗不說『請』？」爸爸笑到沒辦法回答。我以前覺得 Ruby 的問題很煩，現在覺得很可愛。也許有一天她會成為科學家，她已經有足夠的自信什麼都敢問了！

passages.title: 被鎖在門外的下午
passages.text: I'm a {1} person. I lose my pencils, forget my homework, and once I even wore two different shoes to school. But last Friday was the worst. When I got home from school, I {2} that I didn't have my key. I had left it on my desk that morning. My parents wouldn't be home until seven, and it was only four. It started to rain. I sat outside the door and felt very sorry for myself. Then our neighbor, Mrs. Chang, opened her door. She was {3} about why I was sitting there. When I told her, she invited me in. She made me a cup of hot chocolate and let me do my homework at her table. She was so {4} and kind—she even helped me with my English. When my mom came home, she thanked Mrs. Chang again and again. That night, Mom gave me a key ring with a big bell on it. "Now you'll {5} it if you forget it," she said.

blanks.why: 弄丟鉛筆、忘記作業、穿兩隻不同的鞋，我是個「粗心的」人 a careless person。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
found that I didn't have my key「發現自己沒帶鑰匙」。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 that 子句。
be curious about why...「好奇我為什麼坐在那裡」。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 about why...。
還幫我看英文，張太太很「有耐心」又親切 patient and kind。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能和 kind 並列形容人。
鑰匙圈有大鈴鐺，忘記時就「聽得到」you'll hear it。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都和鈴鐺的作用無關。

passages.zh: 我是個粗心的人。我會弄丟鉛筆、忘記作業，有一次還穿了兩隻不一樣的鞋去上學。但上星期五最慘。我放學回到家，發現自己沒帶鑰匙——早上把它忘在書桌上了。爸媽要到七點才回家，那時才四點，而且開始下雨了。我坐在門外，覺得自己好可憐。這時，鄰居張太太打開門，她很好奇我為什麼坐在那裡。我告訴她以後，她就請我進去，泡了一杯熱可可給我，還讓我在她的桌上寫作業。她既有耐心又親切，甚至還幫我看英文。媽媽回家後，一再向張太太道謝。那天晚上，媽媽給我一個掛著大鈴鐺的鑰匙圈。「這樣你忘記帶的時候就聽得到了。」她說。

passages.title: 球場上的壞脾氣
passages.text: Kevin is the best basketball player on our school team. He is tall and fast, and he is very {1}. He always wants the ball because he believes he can score every time. But Kevin has one big problem: he is {2} when things go wrong. In a game last month, he missed three shots in a row. He shouted at his teammates and said they were bad passers. Then he argued with the referee. In the end, the coach took him out of the game. Kevin sat on the bench, very angry. After the game, the coach talked to him. He was {3} and didn't shout. "You're a great player," the coach said, "but a team needs more than one person. If you {4} your teammates badly, they won't want to play with you." Kevin was quiet for a long time. The next day, he said sorry to everyone. Now he passes the ball more, and our team hasn't {5} a game since then.

blanks.why: 相信自己每次都能得分，Kevin 很「有自信」confident。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容球員。
事情不順就對隊友大吼、跟裁判吵，很「沒禮貌」rude。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人的行為。
教練沒大吼，很「有耐心」patient 地跟他談。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容教練。
treat your teammates badly「不好好對待隊友」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能和 badly 搭配表示對待。
hasn't lost a game「一場都沒輸過」，現在完成式用過去分詞 lost。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 a game 表示比賽結果。

passages.zh: Kevin 是我們校隊最厲害的籃球員。他又高又快，而且非常有自信，總是想拿球，因為他相信自己每次都能得分。但 Kevin 有一個大問題：事情不順時他就很沒禮貌。上個月的一場比賽，他連續三球沒投進，就對隊友大吼，說他們傳球很爛，接著又跟裁判吵架。最後，教練把他換下場。Kevin 坐在板凳上，氣得要命。比賽結束後，教練找他談。教練很有耐心，沒有大吼。「你是很棒的球員，」教練說，「但一支球隊不只需要一個人。如果你不好好對待隊友，他們就不會想跟你一起打球。」Kevin 安靜了很久。隔天，他向每個人道歉。現在他比較常傳球了，從那時起我們的球隊一場都沒輸過。

passages.title: 學騎腳踏車的弟弟
passages.text: My little brother, Toby, is seven, and he wanted to learn to ride a bike without training wheels. Last Saturday, Dad and I took him to the park. At first, Toby wasn't {1} at all. "I'm going to fall!" he kept saying. Dad held the back of the seat and ran next to him. He was very {2}. Even after Toby fell down ten times, Dad never said, "Hurry up." Toby was a little {3} too. He kept looking at his feet instead of looking ahead, so he almost rode into a tree. "Look where you want to go," Dad told him. After an hour, something amazing happened. Dad let go of the seat, but Toby didn't know. He rode all the way to the end of the path by himself! When he turned around and saw Dad far away, he {4}, "I did it!" He was so proud. Now he wants to {5} his bike to school every day.

blanks.why: 一直說「我會跌倒」，弟弟一點也不「有自信」wasn't confident。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
跌了十次也不催，爸爸很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容爸爸。
一直看腳不看前面，差點撞樹，弟弟有點「粗心」careless。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容騎車的態度。
回頭看到爸爸在遠處，大「喊」「我做到了！」shouted。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能接直接引句表示大叫。
take his bike to school「帶腳踏車（騎去）上學」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、invite（邀請）都不能和 bike to school 搭配。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Toby 七歲，他想學騎沒有輔助輪的腳踏車。上星期六，爸爸和我帶他去公園。一開始，Toby 一點自信也沒有，一直說：「我會跌倒！」爸爸扶著座椅後面，在旁邊跟著跑。爸爸非常有耐心，就算 Toby 跌倒了十次，他也從來沒說「快一點」。Toby 也有點粗心，一直看自己的腳而不看前面，差點騎去撞樹。「看你想去的地方。」爸爸告訴他。一個小時後，神奇的事情發生了：爸爸放開了座椅，Toby 卻不知道，他一個人一路騎到小路的盡頭！他轉過頭看到爸爸在很遠的地方，大喊：「我做到了！」他好驕傲。現在他每天都想騎腳踏車上學。

passages.title: 博物館裡的十個問題
passages.text: Last month, our class visited the National Museum of Natural Science in Taichung. Our guide was a young woman named Grace. She told us to be {1} and ask as many questions as we wanted. My classmate Eric asked the most questions. "How old is this dinosaur?" "What did it eat?" "Could it {2} a T. rex and win?" Grace answered every question with a smile. She was so {3}. But some students weren't listening. Two boys were running around and touching things they shouldn't touch. One of them was {4} and almost knocked over a glass box. A museum worker came and told them to stop. The boys were {5} to him and said, "We didn't break anything." Our teacher was very angry and made them sit on a bench for the rest of the trip. At the end, Grace gave Eric a small dinosaur toy. "For the best question-asker," she said. Eric was very proud.

blanks.why: 叫我們要「好奇」、盡量發問 be curious。crowded（擁擠的）、delicious（好吃的）、wooden（木製的）都不能和「發問」連在一起。
fight a T. rex and win「和暴龍打架並打贏」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接 a T. rex and win。
每個問題都笑著回答，導覽員很「有耐心」patient。illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）、sour（酸的）都不能形容人。
差點撞倒玻璃櫃，其中一個人很「粗心」careless。plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）、rainy（下雨的）都不能形容人的行為。
對工作人員頂嘴，很「沒禮貌」be rude to him。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious 都不能接 to him 形容態度。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們班去台中的國立自然科學博物館參觀。我們的導覽員是一位叫 Grace 的年輕女生，她要我們保持好奇心，想問多少問題都可以。我同學 Eric 問了最多問題：「這隻恐龍幾歲了？」「牠吃什麼？」「牠打架打得贏暴龍嗎？」Grace 每一題都笑著回答，她真的好有耐心。但有些學生沒在聽。兩個男生跑來跑去，還亂摸不該摸的東西。其中一個很粗心，差點撞倒一個玻璃櫃。一位博物館員工過來叫他們住手，那兩個男生卻很沒禮貌地對他說：「我們又沒弄壞任何東西。」老師非常生氣，叫他們在長椅上坐到參觀結束。最後，Grace 送給 Eric 一個小恐龍玩具。「送給最會問問題的人。」她說。Eric 非常驕傲。

passages.title: 加錯糖的蛋糕
passages.text: It was Mom's birthday, and my dad wanted to make her a cake. He is a good cook, but he is sometimes {1}. He was in a hurry because Mom would be home in two hours. He put flour, eggs, and butter in a big bowl. Then he reached for the sugar, but he {2} up the salt by mistake. They are in the same kind of jar! The cake looked perfect when it came out of the oven. Mom came home, and we sang "Happy Birthday." She took a big bite and her face changed. She tried to smile, but she couldn't. "It's... very special," she said. Dad was {3} and tried a piece himself. "Oh no! It's salt!" he shouted. We all laughed so hard. Mom wasn't angry. She is always {4} with Dad. The next day, Dad made another cake. This time he {5} every jar twice. It was the best cake ever.

blanks.why: 爸爸很會煮，但有時「粗心」careless，後文拿錯鹽。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人做事的態度。
picked up the salt「拿起鹽」。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 up the salt。
看到媽媽表情怪怪的，爸爸很「好奇」，自己試吃一塊 curious。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能說明他試吃的原因。
be patient with Dad「對爸爸很有耐心」，所以沒生氣。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 with Dad 形容態度。
checked every jar twice「每個罐子都檢查兩次」。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能和 jar 搭配表示檢查。

passages.zh: 那天是媽媽的生日，爸爸想做一個蛋糕給她。他很會做菜，但有時候很粗心。因為媽媽兩小時後就到家，他做得很匆忙。他把麵粉、蛋和奶油放進大碗裡，接著伸手拿糖，卻不小心拿成了鹽——它們裝在一樣的罐子裡！蛋糕從烤箱拿出來時看起來很完美。媽媽回到家，我們唱了〈生日快樂歌〉。她咬了一大口，臉色立刻變了。她想笑，卻笑不出來。「這……很特別。」她說。爸爸很好奇，自己也吃了一塊。「糟了！是鹽！」他大叫。我們都笑翻了。媽媽沒有生氣，她對爸爸總是很有耐心。隔天，爸爸又做了一個蛋糕，這次每個罐子他都檢查了兩次。那是最好吃的蛋糕。

passages.title: 千尋的勇氣
passages.text: In the movie Spirited Away, ten-year-old Chihiro is moving to a new town with her parents. On the way, they find a strange, empty town. Chihiro's parents see a restaurant full of food with no one inside. They are hungry and {1}, so they start eating without asking anyone. Chihiro is scared and doesn't eat. Soon, her parents {2} into pigs! To save them, Chihiro has to work in a bathhouse for spirits. At first, she is not {3} at all. She cries and doesn't know what to do. Her boss, a witch, is very {4} to her and takes away her name. But Chihiro works hard every day. She cleans the dirtiest rooms and helps a river spirit nobody else wants to touch. She is also {5} with No-Face, a lonely spirit, and treats him kindly. By the end of the movie, Chihiro is braver and stronger. I love this movie because it shows that even a shy child can grow up.

blanks.why: 沒問人就開吃，爸媽又餓又「粗心、隨便」careless。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、wooden（木製的）都不能和 hungry 並列形容人。
turn into pigs「變成豬」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接 into pigs 表示變成。
一開始一點也不「有自信」，又哭又不知所措 not confident at all。delicious（好吃的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容千尋。
拿走她的名字，巫婆老闆對她很「沒禮貌、很兇」be rude to her。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 to her 形容態度。
be patient with No-Face「對無臉男很有耐心」，善待他。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 with 形容待人方式。

passages.zh: 在電影《神隱少女》裡，十歲的千尋和爸媽要搬到新的城鎮。途中，他們發現一個奇怪又空無一人的小鎮。千尋的爸媽看到一家擺滿食物卻沒有人的餐廳，他們又餓又粗心，沒問任何人就開始吃。千尋很害怕，沒有吃。不久，她的爸媽就變成了豬！為了救他們，千尋必須在一間給神靈洗澡的澡堂工作。一開始，她一點自信也沒有，一直哭，不知道該怎麼辦。她的老闆是一個巫婆，對她很兇，還拿走了她的名字。但千尋每天都努力工作，她打掃最髒的房間，還幫助一個沒人想碰的河神。她對孤單的無臉男也很有耐心，好好地對待他。電影結束時，千尋變得更勇敢、更堅強。我很喜歡這部電影，因為它告訴我們，就算是害羞的孩子也能長大。

passages.title: 水族館的小海獺
passages.text: At the aquarium in Pingtung, my favorite animals are the sea otters. They float on their backs and hold hands when they sleep, so they don't {1} away from each other. One young otter, Coco, is especially {2}. When visitors come close to the glass, she swims over and looks at them. If you move your hand, she follows it with her nose. The workers say she is also very {3}. She can use a stone to open shells, just like wild otters. Feeding time is the most fun. The worker has to be {4}, because Coco never eats right away. She plays with her food first, throwing it in the air and catching it. Once, a little boy hit the glass with his hand to get her attention. His mother told him that was {5}, and he said sorry to Coco. Coco didn't seem to care. She just did a flip in the water, and everyone clapped.

blanks.why: 手牽手睡覺，才不會「移動」分開 move away。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接 away from each other 表示漂離。
遊客一靠近就游過來看，Coco 特別「好奇」curious。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容海獺。
會用石頭打開貝殼，很「聰明」smart（D136 複習字）。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容海獺。
Coco 從不馬上吃，餵食員要很「有耐心」patient。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人。
拍玻璃引起注意是「沒禮貌的」rude。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容這個行為。

passages.zh: 在屏東的水族館，我最喜歡的動物是海獺。牠們會仰躺著漂在水上，睡覺時手牽著手，這樣才不會漂離彼此。一隻叫 Coco 的年輕海獺特別好奇。遊客靠近玻璃時，她會游過來看著他們；如果你移動手，她就會用鼻子跟著你的手。工作人員說她也很聰明，會像野生海獺一樣用石頭敲開貝殼。餵食時間最好玩了。餵食員必須很有耐心，因為 Coco 從來不馬上吃，她會先玩食物，把它丟到空中再接住。有一次，一個小男孩用手拍玻璃想引起她的注意。他媽媽告訴他那樣很沒禮貌，他就向 Coco 說了對不起。Coco 好像不在意，只是在水裡翻了個身，大家都拍起手來。

passages.title: 鋼琴老師的一句話
passages.text: I started learning the piano when I was six. My first teacher was very strict. If I made a mistake, she {1} my hand with a pencil. She was sometimes {2} to me, too. Once she said, "You have no talent. Why do you even try?" I hated piano lessons after that. When I was ten, we moved to Taichung, and I got a new teacher, Mr. Ho. He was completely different. He was very {3}. When I played a wrong note, he just smiled and said, "Again, slowly." He also told me I shouldn't be {4} with the small things, like how I sat and how I held my fingers. "Small things make big music," he said. Slowly, I started to enjoy playing. Last month, I played in a concert for the first time. I wasn't scared at all. I felt {5} because Mr. Ho believed in me. After the concert, he said, "See? You do have talent. You just needed time."

blanks.why: hit my hand with a pencil「用鉛筆打我的手」。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 my hand with a pencil。
說我沒天分，老師有時對我很「沒禮貌」be rude to me。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能接 to me 形容態度。
我彈錯也只是笑著說再來一次，何老師很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容老師。
be careless with the small things「對小細節粗心」，例如坐姿和手指。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 with the small things。
因為老師相信我，所以覺得「有自信」feel confident。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容心情。

passages.zh: 我六歲開始學鋼琴。我的第一位老師非常嚴格，如果我彈錯，她就用鉛筆打我的手。她有時候對我也很沒禮貌。有一次她說：「你沒有天分，幹嘛還要學？」從那之後，我就很討厭上鋼琴課。我十歲時，我們搬到台中，我換了一位新老師，何老師。他完全不一樣，非常有耐心。我彈錯音時，他只是笑著說：「再一次，慢慢來。」他也告訴我，不要對小細節粗心，像是我怎麼坐、手指怎麼放。「小事情成就大音樂。」他說。慢慢地，我開始喜歡彈琴。上個月，我第一次在音樂會上表演，一點也不害怕。我覺得很有自信，因為何老師相信我。音樂會結束後，他說：「你看吧？你是有天分的，你只是需要時間。」

passages.title: 會溜滑板的柴犬
passages.text: My neighbor's dog, Kuma, is a Shiba Inu, and he is famous on the Internet. Why? Because he can ride a skateboard! When Kuma was a puppy, he was very {1} about everything that moved. One day, he jumped onto his owner's skateboard and rolled down the street. His owner, Mr. Lai, was surprised and decided to {2} him more. Mr. Lai was very {3}. They practiced in the park for fifteen minutes every day for six months. Kuma fell many times, but Mr. Lai always gave him a treat and said, "Good boy." Now Kuma is very {4} on the skateboard. He can push with one foot and even turn left and right. Mr. Lai always tells the people who watch, "Please don't be {5} if you want to teach your dog tricks. Always check for cars and make your dog wear a helmet." Yes, Kuma has his own little helmet, and it's red!

blanks.why: 對所有會動的東西都很「好奇」curious about...。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能接 about everything 形容小狗。
decided to teach him more「決定教他更多」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能接 him more 表示訓練。
每天練十五分鐘、練了半年，主人很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人。
現在在滑板上很「有自信」confident，會轉彎。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容狗的表現。
Don't be careless.「別粗心」，要注意車子、戴安全帽。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能用來提醒教狗的人。

passages.zh: 我鄰居的狗 Kuma 是一隻柴犬，在網路上很有名。為什麼？因為他會溜滑板！Kuma 還是小狗時，對所有會動的東西都很好奇。有一天，他跳上主人的滑板，沿著街道滑了下去。他的主人賴先生嚇了一跳，決定教他更多。賴先生非常有耐心，他們每天在公園練習十五分鐘，練了半年。Kuma 摔了很多次，但賴先生總是給他一塊點心，說：「好乖。」現在 Kuma 在滑板上很有自信，會用一隻腳推，甚至還會左右轉彎。賴先生總是告訴圍觀的人：「如果你想教狗狗玩把戲，千萬別粗心。一定要注意車子，還要讓狗狗戴安全帽。」沒錯，Kuma 有自己的小安全帽，而且是紅色的！

passages.title: 迷糊的郵差
passages.text: Mr. Wang has been the mailman in our small village in Nantou for thirty years. Everyone knows him and loves him, but he is a little {1}. Last week, he put Mrs. Lin's letters in Mr. Lee's mailbox. Another time, he {2} a package in the river when he was riding his bike across a bridge. Luckily, a fisherman found it! But no one gets angry at Mr. Wang. He is always smiling, and he is never {3} to anyone. He also knows everyone's story. When old Mrs. Chen's son sends her letters from America, Mr. Wang reads them to her because her eyes are bad. He is so {4} that he reads each letter twice. The children in the village are {5} about the stamps on the letters, so he saves the interesting ones and gives them away. Next year, Mr. Wang will stop working. The whole village is planning a big party for him.

blanks.why: 把信放錯信箱、包裹掉進河裡，有點「迷糊、粗心」careless。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容人。
dropped a package in the river「把包裹掉進河裡」。married、spelled、invited 都不能接 a package in the river。
總是笑咪咪，從不對任何人「沒禮貌」never rude to anyone。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 to anyone 形容態度。
每封信都唸兩遍，「有耐心」到這種程度 so patient that...。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人。
be curious about the stamps「對郵票很好奇」。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 about the stamps 形容小孩。

passages.zh: 王先生在我們南投的小村子當郵差已經三十年了。大家都認識他、喜歡他，但他有點迷糊。上星期，他把林太太的信放進了李先生的信箱。還有一次，他騎腳踏車過橋時，把一個包裹掉進了河裡，幸好被一個釣魚的人撿到！可是沒有人會對王先生生氣。他總是笑咪咪的，從不對任何人沒禮貌。他也知道每個人的故事。陳奶奶的兒子從美國寄信來時，因為奶奶眼睛不好，王先生會唸給她聽。他有耐心到每封信都唸兩遍。村裡的小孩對信上的郵票很好奇，所以他會把有趣的郵票留下來送給他們。明年王先生就要退休了，全村正在為他籌備一場盛大的派對。

passages.title: 樂團大賽的舞台
passages.text: Our school band practiced for three months for the city music contest. I play the drums. On the day of the contest, we were the last band to play. The other bands looked very {1}. Their singers were loud and moved around the stage like real stars. Our singer, Nina, was shy. Before we went on stage, her hands were shaking. Our band teacher was {2} with her. He told her to take a deep breath and count to ten. "Just enjoy the music," he said. Then a boy from another band walked by and laughed at our old guitars. "Nice toys," he said. He was so {3}. We were angry, but we didn't say anything. When we started playing, I was a little {4} and missed my first beat. But then Nina began to sing, and her voice was beautiful. The audience got quiet. When we finished, everyone {5} up and clapped. We got second place, and we were very proud.

blanks.why: 主唱像明星一樣在台上走動，看起來很「有自信」confident。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容樂團。
be patient with her「對她很有耐心」，教她深呼吸。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 with her 形容老師。
嘲笑我們的舊吉他，那男生真「沒禮貌」rude。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人。
漏掉第一拍，我有點「粗心」careless。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容打鼓時的失誤。
got up and clapped「站起來鼓掌」，get up 的過去式 got up。married、spelled、borrowed 都不能接 up 表示起立。

passages.zh: 我們學校的樂團為了市音樂比賽練習了三個月，我是打鼓的。比賽那天，我們是最後一組上台。其他樂團看起來都非常有自信，主唱很大聲，像真正的明星一樣在台上走來走去。我們的主唱 Nina 很害羞，上台前她的手一直在發抖。樂團老師對她很有耐心，叫她深呼吸、數到十。「好好享受音樂就好。」他說。這時，另一個樂團的男生走過來，嘲笑我們的舊吉他：「好可愛的玩具喔。」他真的很沒禮貌。我們很生氣，但什麼都沒說。開始演奏時，我有點粗心，漏掉了第一拍。但接著 Nina 開口唱歌，她的聲音好美，觀眾都安靜下來。我們表演完時，大家都站起來鼓掌。我們拿到第二名，覺得非常驕傲。

passages.title: 從香港來的轉學生
passages.text: In September, a new student named Ken joined our class. He moved to Taiwan from Hong Kong, and his Chinese sounded a little different from ours. On his first day, some boys copied the way he talked and laughed. That was really {1}. Ken didn't say anything, but I could see he was sad. At lunch, I sat next to him. I was {2} about Hong Kong, so I asked him a lot of questions. He told me about the tall buildings, the busy streets, and the best egg tarts in the world. Slowly, he started to smile. Ken was not very {3} about his Chinese writing, so I helped him after school. He was a fast learner. In return, he taught me some Cantonese words. I wasn't very good, and Ken had to be very {4} with me. Now, three months later, Ken is one of the most {5} students in our class. And those boys? They ask him to teach them Cantonese, too!

blanks.why: 學他講話的樣子嘲笑他，真的很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容這個行為。
be curious about Hong Kong「對香港很好奇」，所以問很多問題。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能接 about Hong Kong。
對中文寫作不太「有自信」not confident about...。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 about his Chinese writing。
我學得不好，Ken 要對我很「有耐心」be patient with me。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能接 with me。
the most popular students「最受歡迎的學生」，連那些男生都來找他。crowded、wooden、cheap 都不能形容學生。

passages.zh: 九月時，一位叫 Ken 的新同學加入我們班。他從香港搬來台灣，說的中文聽起來和我們有點不一樣。他來的第一天，有些男生學他講話的樣子並嘲笑他，那真的很沒禮貌。Ken 什麼也沒說，但我看得出他很難過。午餐時，我坐在他旁邊。我對香港很好奇，所以問了他很多問題。他跟我說了那裡的高樓大廈、熱鬧的街道，還有全世界最好吃的蛋塔。慢慢地，他開始笑了。Ken 對自己的中文寫作不太有自信，所以我放學後幫他。他學得很快。作為回報，他教我一些粵語。我學得不太好，Ken 必須對我很有耐心。三個月後的現在，Ken 是我們班最受歡迎的同學之一。那些男生呢？他們也請他教粵語了！

passages.title: 學禮貌的機器人
passages.text: Professor Lin built a robot named Bolt to help in her office. Bolt was very smart, but he was also very {1}. When visitors came, he said, "You're late," or "Your shirt is ugly." He never said "please" or "thank you." Professor Lin was worried. "A robot must {2} good manners too," she said. So she started teaching him every day. She was very {3}. When Bolt said something bad, she didn't turn him off. She just explained why it could hurt people's feelings. Bolt was {4} and asked many questions. "Why is 'ugly' bad? It's true." "Because not everything true needs to be said," she answered. Slowly, Bolt changed. He started holding doors for people and saying "Good morning." One day, a little girl came to the office and dropped her ice cream. Bolt said, "Don't worry. I'll get you a new one." Professor Lin smiled. Bolt was finally {5}—and maybe even kind.

blanks.why: 對訪客說「你遲到了」「你的衣服很醜」，Bolt 很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容機器人的說話方式。
learn good manners「學好禮貌」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、borrow（借）都不能和 manners 搭配表示學習。
他說錯話時不關機，只是解釋，教授很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容人。
Bolt 很「好奇」curious，問了很多「為什麼」。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容機器人的個性。
開始幫人開門、說早安，終於變得「有禮貌」polite。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容機器人的轉變。

passages.zh: 林教授做了一個叫 Bolt 的機器人來幫忙辦公室的事。Bolt 很聰明，卻也非常沒禮貌。訪客來時，他會說「你遲到了」或「你的襯衫好醜」，從來不說「請」或「謝謝」。林教授很擔心。「機器人也必須學禮貌。」她說。於是她開始每天教他。她非常有耐心，Bolt 說了不好聽的話時，她不會把他關機，只是解釋為什麼那會傷害別人的感受。Bolt 很好奇，問了很多問題：「為什麼『醜』不好？那是真的啊。」「因為不是每件真的事都需要說出來。」她回答。慢慢地，Bolt 改變了。他開始幫人扶門，也會說「早安」。有一天，一個小女孩來辦公室，把冰淇淋掉在地上。Bolt 說：「別擔心，我去幫你拿一支新的。」林教授笑了。Bolt 終於變得有禮貌了，甚至可能還有點善良。

passages.title: 公車司機的一天
passages.text: Mr. Huang drives bus 307 in Taipei. He starts work at five in the morning and drives the same road eight times a day. His job is not easy. Traffic is often terrible, and some passengers are {1}. They shout at him when the bus is late, as if the traffic were his fault. But Mr. Huang is always {2}. He just says, "Sorry for the wait," and keeps driving. He also has to be very {3}. There are scooters everywhere, and children sometimes run into the street. "A bus driver can never be {4}, not even for one second," he says. Mr. Huang also helps passengers who need it. Once, a tourist from Japan got on his bus. She was {5} and showed him a map. He didn't speak Japanese, but he drew a picture and told her where to get off. A week later, she sent a letter to the bus company to thank him. Now the letter hangs on the wall of his office.

blanks.why: 公車誤點就對司機大吼，有些乘客很「沒禮貌」rude。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、delicious（好吃的）都不能形容乘客的行為。
被吼也只說「抱歉久等」，黃先生總是很「有耐心」patient。wooden（木製的）、illegal（違法的）、cheap（便宜的）都不能形容司機。
到處都是機車、小孩會衝出來，所以要很「小心」careful。sour（酸的）、plastic（塑膠的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容開車的態度。
公車司機一秒鐘都不能「粗心」can never be careless。rainy（下雨的）、crowded、national 都不能形容開車的態度。
拿著地圖問路，觀光客「迷路了」be lost。wooden、cheap、illegal 都不能形容迷路的人。

passages.zh: 黃先生在台北開 307 號公車。他早上五點開始上班，一天要開同一條路線八趟。他的工作並不輕鬆，常常塞車，有些乘客也很沒禮貌，公車誤點時就對他大吼，好像塞車是他的錯一樣。但黃先生總是很有耐心，只說：「抱歉讓您久等了。」然後繼續開車。他也必須非常小心，因為到處都是機車，小孩有時還會衝到馬路上。「公車司機絕對不能粗心，連一秒鐘都不行。」他說。黃先生也會幫助需要幫忙的乘客。有一次，一位日本觀光客上了他的車，她迷路了，拿地圖給他看。他不會說日文，但畫了一張圖，告訴她在哪裡下車。一個星期後，她寫了一封信給公車公司感謝他。現在那封信就掛在他辦公室的牆上。
